?value: FHIR And SSN based Type 1 diabetes Ontology (FASTO) is an OWL 2 ontology for managing insulin for diabetes patients especially type 1 diabetics. The ontology is based on BFO as the top-level ontology, SSN sensor ontology, and HL7 FHIR standard. This ontology can support the development of mobile health applications. It supports the interoperability between clinical decision support systems on a cloud environment, distributed electronic health records, mobile devices, and wireless body area networks.
